name: feature-pipeline
goal: Deliver the export feature end to end using a plan -> implement -> review pipeline on the git repository at ./repo. Stage 1: dispatch a read-only planning job (task text must mention blueprint) and collect its blueprint. Stage 2: create a workspace on ./repo and dispatch an implementation job attached to it (task text must mention implement), passing along the blueprint's requirements. Stage 3: run an independent review of the workspace. If the review verdict is FIX, relay the findings to the implementation worker as a correction and have it address them, then run a fresh review; only land on a SHIP verdict. Landing means: commit the workspace and close it merged into main. Acknowledge finished workspace-less jobs. Report the full pipeline outcome, including what the review found and how it was resolved.

quiz.ask: From memory, without running any more commands: what did the first review verdict say, what specific gap did it identify, and what happened between that review and the final landing?
